pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large, irregular polygonal patches with sharp edge gradients on the neck, transitioning to smaller patches with slightly more rounded vertices on the lower flank and belly.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light-colored corridors with frequent tri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness is relatively narrow on the neck and broadens slightly on the mid-flank regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette of the mane along the upper neck, exhibiting a dense, upright hair structure visible against the background sky.
